metadata.case_name: WAI CHING FONG v. LEUNG YAU NAM AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: dishwasher employed by the defendants in their restaurant in Fo Tan, Shatin

source: she had also fractured her left humerus.
a fracture of the left humerus; and a scar on her right calf where the plaintiff was scalded by hot soup.
PW1 noted that the bone fracture was not "displaced", in other words the broken parts of the humerus bone had not moved out of position.
PW1 found no damage whatsoever to the nerve located in that area, hence his remark "without neurological complication".

source: After the accident the doctor at the Prince of Wales Hospital found scald wounds on both of her legs.

In 1997 PW1 found ... a scar on her right calf where the plaintiff was scalded by hot soup.
